name: ghosttea
description: Ghostty-powered native terminal runtime for Electron applications.
author: James Yong

scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspace ghosttea-demo
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build --workspace @vibecook/ghosttea-protocol && npm run build --workspace @vibecook/ghosttea-frame && npm run build --workspace @vibecook/ghosttea && npm run build --workspace @vibecook/ghosttea-electron && npm run build --workspace @vibecook/ghosttea-react
scripts.package:check: npm run build:sdk && npm run package:ghostty-vt && node scripts/check-packages.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build:sdk && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && cargo check --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.dev: npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --workspace ghosttea-demo
scripts.test: npm run build:sdk && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && cargo test --workspace && npm run test:integration
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts tests bench *.js --max-warnings 0
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/desktop/src packages scripts tests bench *.json *.js *.md && cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/desktop/src packages scripts tests bench *.json *.js *.md && cargo fmt --all -- --check
